body:
- Refactors module loading - all modules are now sub-modules of the `Land` module
 - Add `Project.toml` and `Manifest.toml`
 - Remove temporary files, and `.gitignore`

With this PR, one can `julia --project; using Land` without errors.

I haven't tried running the Jupiter notebooks, so some of them may need small changes to run properly. Also, for some reason, git did not properly track some of the renamed files (e.g., `testODE.jl`)
title: Refactor module loading, make proper package with deps
